overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether a leading '*' is passed (list as object-name string vs. list reference number). Merged into one semantic overload with that param optional. Also corrected direction: icon is filled in by the command ('←' in the docs), not passed in; added the 0/'*' sentinel values documented for itemRef.

params.description: If present, 'list' below is an object name (string); if omitted, 'list' is a hierarchical list reference number.

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to the list (via APPEND TO LIST)
the current item of the list

params.name: icon
params.description: Icon associated with the item, regardless of its source (static picture, resource, or picture expression); returned empty if the item has no icon.
